identity: Whitebridge sells the same river basket twice while poachers, wolves and wetland collectors each claim a toll.

quests.title: [PH] The Waiting Still Eat
quests.text: [PH] Merren Oakstamp feeds the people whose paid delivery never came: bring 8 Corn. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Merren Oakstamp feeds the people whose paid delivery never came: bring 8 Corn. Real text to follow.
[PH] Brakka Jarward feeds the cutting crews before the next shift: bring 8 Corn. Real text to follow.

quests.title: [PH] Have the Ramp Measured
quests.text: [PH] Jessa Axlewright sends the player to Halen Chalkthumb at Bridgechalk Dig, who should fix the ferry ramp's repair to a measure that holds. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).

quests.title: [PH] Two Pickups for One Basket
quests.text: [PH] Merren Oakstamp wants the stored baskets at Market Close checked against the pickup records; two buyers hold slips for the same basket. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Merren sees which slip is real; her market keeps its good name. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] Thorn's Double Sale
quests.text: [PH] Merren sends the player against Basket-Poacher Thorn in the {name:willowbanks}, who sells the same goods twice. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Thorn sells nothing more; Merren's customers get their baskets. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: [PH] Stone for the Ferry Ramp
